newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain says Q1 jobless fall reflects growth pick-up.
newsitem.headline: Spain says Q1 jobless fall reflects growth pick-up.

text.p: A fall in Spain's jobless rate in the first quarter reflects an economic pick-up, the Economy Ministry said on Monday.

"(First quarter jobless data) show an acceleration in the rate of growth which other activity indicators show. The growth of employment continues to be intense and at the same time there is a substantial fall in the still-high unemployment rate," a statement said.
A National Statistics Institute survey showed today that the jobless rate in the first quarter fell to 21.49 percent from 21.78 percent in the fourth quarter.
